name: GRAMMER AG
brief: Makes passenger and driver seats for trains; we consider them for our seat sourcing.
summary: GRAMMER AG runs a large, globally integrated network of over 40 production and logistics sites, giving it operational scale but also exposing it to supply‑chain opacity. A supplier‑quality bottleneck has already forced a business‑on‑hold status, signalling limited visibility into sub‑tier vendors. The company’s credit‑risk accounting shows measurable credit exposure, while market signals are mixed – revenue is falling yet operating EBIT is rising and the share trades in a wide 52‑week range. Valuation looks attractive versus peers (P/E 7.09× vs. 15.25× industry average), and ESG performance is improving with a silver EcoVadis rating, CDP B grade and a 25 % CO₂‑reduction milestone already met.

insights.headline: Sub‑tier visibility risk – supplier quality issues causing a supply bottleneck
Credit‑rating exposure – credit‑risk changes recorded in OCI, indicating material credit risk
Market sentiment mixed – revenue down 5.8 % but operating EBIT up; share price volatile (€5.40‑€16.40 52‑wk range)
Industry benchmark favorable – P/E 7.09× well below sector average 15.25×
Operational resilience moderate – 40+ integrated global facilities provide scale but no disclosed disruption history
ESG improving – EcoVadis upgraded to silver, CDP B in 2022, 25 % CO₂ cut achieved, net‑zero 2040 target set
